text.en: My Number Card: if it was only suspended, take the found card to your municipality (Nagoya: ward office) and have the suspension lifted; you can keep using it. You do not need to call the hotline.

text.en: Residence card: if you find the old card after getting a new one, return the old card to immigration within 14 days (to be checked).

text.ja_easy: カード：{会社|かいしゃ}に{聞|き}きます。
text.en: Bank and credit cards: whether a stopped card can be used again depends on the company. Ask them (to be checked).

text.en: Passport: even if you find it after filing the notice, you cannot use it. Take it to the passport counter to be punched.

text.en: Items reported to the police can be searched online for 3 months from the report.

text.en: If a bank or similar tells you your item is at the police, phone that police station, confirm the details, and then go to collect it.
